title: rosa gallica f. pseudolivescens
intro: Rosa gallica f. pseudolivescens, commonly known as French rose, is a fragrant and highly scented rose species. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, improving mood, and promoting relaxation due to its sedative and calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica f. pseudolivescens include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and promoting smooth muscle relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although more research is needed to fully understand its bioactive constituents.
